desc: Meet the next evolution in precision hunting rifles: a rugged, performance-first platform wrapped in a new flat dark gray 110 Trophy stock with user-friendly LOP adjustment and a tungsten-Cerakoted barreled action for long-lasting corrosion resistance. Built for accuracy and handling, it features a jeweled bolt body, a user-adjustable AccuTrigger, carbon fiber barrel with a threaded muzzle, and a one-piece 0 MOA rail. Practicality meets modern design with a detachable box magazine, multiple caliber options (including left-hand configurations), and the balance and refinement to perform from the truck to the mountain.
